dp_numeric_menu_desc: Configure percentage text for observers and targets.
dp_observer_numeric_menu_desc: Configure percentage text for guards, civilians, cameras, and player waypoints.
dp_targets_menu_desc: Configure suspicious target indicators and target classes.
dp_subdued_check_icon_desc: Marks already-subdued civilians with a checkmark so free ones stand out.
dp_show_early_unmasked_suspicion_desc: Show suspicion indicators during the hidden noticing phase while unmasked.
dp_enable_detection_sync_desc: Host sends live detection data. Clients receive it when both sides have the mod and this option enabled.
dp_client_aggregate_fallback_desc: Without host sync, all observing guards show the highest suspicion value from nearby players.
dp_show_numeric_values_desc: Master switch for all suspicion percentage numbers.
dp_show_numeric_observers_desc: Show suspicion % on guards and cameras noticing something. Sub-options control where.
dp_numeric_observer_waypoints_desc: Replace off-screen directional arrows with the detection percentage.
dp_numeric_observer_units_desc: Show detection % above on-screen guards and cameras that are noticing something.
dp_show_numeric_targets_desc: Show detection % on bags, bodies, and objects being investigated.
dp_show_targets_desc: Show a filling suspicion indicator on things guards or cameras are looking at.
dp_target_other_players_desc: Show the suspicion indicator on teammates being noticed by NPCs or cameras.
dp_target_subdued_npcs_desc: Show the suspicion indicator on NPCs and bodies
dp_target_bags_desc: Show the suspicion indicator on loot bags, drills, and other carryables.
dp_target_suspicious_objects_desc: Show the suspicion indicator on broken windows, open doors, hacked computers, and similar map objects.
dp_colors_menu_desc: Customize indicator colors for each suspicion stage.
dp_separate_alerted_color_desc: Use a different color for the alerted state instead of inheriting from critical.
dp_colors_reset_desc: Restore all suspicion colors to their default values.
dp_color_early_sus_desc: Color used at the very start of suspicion while unmasked.
dp_color_midway_desc: Color used at the middle of the suspicion (around 50%).
dp_color_critical_desc: Color used near the end of detection, just before alert triggers.
